All promoted candidates reviewed claim by claim
Nonqueue stratified sample covers every observed stratum
External semantic claims are independently supported

completed_scope: Verified seven predeclared artifact hashes and recorded all twelve uploaded artifact hashes and sizes.
Reconciled 208 candidates, fingerprints and triggers plus 7032 transitions.
Joined every one of 328 candidate timeline records to an exact complete side-specific 15M source bar.
Produced claim-level records for all six queue-promoted candidates.
Produced a deterministic one-per-stratum review of 20 nonqueue candidates covering every observed side/trigger/quality/parent stratum.
Separated mechanical reproducibility, chronology, trigger reconstruction, structural comparison and external semantic validity.

decision_effects.BLOCK: Stop the assurance programme with evidence preserved.

decision_effects.PASS: Not recommended. Would accept the June market-description reliability claim despite unresolved material evidence failures.
decision_effects.QUARANTINE: Quarantine the June review evidence if the operator treats the binding conflict as unsafe rather than correctable.
decision_effects.SUPERSEDE: Replace this assurance design with a new operator-approved plan.

scope: Materialize an immutable source-to-C2-v2 carry-forward binding receipt without changing source bytes.
Make first_valid_time chronological ordering mandatory in candidate materialization and every read-only projection.
Expose exact C1 fact, level, relation, formula-registry and source-price references for every displayed state claim.
Expose exact pre-trigger histories for persistence and switching triggers.
Expose component distance, weights, scales, thresholds, duplicate and overlap status for every reviewed fingerprint.
Return to PD-JUNE-MDR-G1 after tests and operator review.

recommendation_rationale: The packet proves deterministic artifact integrity and complete price-bar availability for all candidate timestamps, but it also exposes a C2 v1/v2 binding conflict, nonchronological serialized timelines, missing exact C1 claim evidence, incomplete trigger history and no fully supported semantic description. PASS would overstate what the June evidence establishes.
rollback: Preserve all uploaded bytes, prior signed evidence and immutable pilot decisions. Revert only this gate-ready packet and bounded compact review records through a new non-destructive commit.

unresolved_issues.summary: Source binding C2 v1 versus candidate C2 v2 conflict.
Missing exact C1 claim evidence and formula inputs.
Missing pre-trigger histories for persistence and switching.

warnings: The source-binding payload names C2 v1 while the reviewed candidate artifacts name C2 v2.
44 candidate timelines are serialized out of order, including four promoted review units.
No claim can establish external semantic correctness without exact C1 facts, levels and formula inputs.
Persistence and switching triggers cannot be independently reconstructed from the supplied history.
No reviewed candidate receives a full market-description SUPPORT verdict.
